summary: Retest of two iter9 bugs. (A) Mask-zero hidden for unsigned data — PASS (fixed by ±1e-3 tolerance in NiivueViewer.getOverlayInfo). (B) Click-to-edit threshold commit — STILL BROKEN. Snake_case write fix did not resolve the text-edit path; slider drag may work but typing a value + Enter still reverts the label to original. Regression: vertical colorbars on left edge present, asymmetric layout OK, clip plane OK, Reset-to-MNI OK, console clean.

ui_bugs.issue: Click-to-edit threshold value STILL does not commit. Reproduced exactly as iter9. After clicking [data-testid=threshold-hi-benson_polar_angle], filling input with '90' (verified via input.input_value() == '90'), and pressing Enter, the threshold-hi label remains '179.91'. Same for low side: typed '30', label stays '0.00'. Slider thumb does not move. Tested with both keyboard.type and locator.fill — both fail. Dashboard.handleCalRangeChange snake_case fix is correct but does not address the text-edit closure issue.
ui_bugs.repro: 1) Toggle Polar Angle ON, wait 3s. 2) Click hi value '179.91'. 3) Type '90', Enter. 4) Label reverts to 179.91.
ui_bugs.hypothesis: ThresholdValue.useEffect has deps [editing, value]. When parent re-renders with refreshed overlayMeta (refreshOverlayMeta runs via setTimeout 60ms after toggle), `value` prop may shift slightly (e.g. 179.913 -> 179.91 rounding or object identity), causing useEffect to re-fire `setText(value)` and CLOBBER the user's typed '90' back to '179.91'. Then commit() reads parseFloat('179.91')=179.91, which then triggers handleHiText(179.91) → no-op. Fix: split useEffect into one that runs ONLY on `editing` transition true (not on value), e.g. useEffect(()=>{ if(editing) { setText(...); setTimeout(()=>inputRef.current?.select(),10); } }, [editing]). Or use a ref instead of state for the seed value.

action_items: [HIGH] Fix LayerControlAdvanced.jsx ThresholdValue useEffect dependency. Currently `useEffect(()=>{...}, [editing, value])` — when parent re-renders with updated value mid-edit, the user's typed text is overwritten back to `value`. Change to `useEffect(()=>{ if(editing){ setText(String(Number(value).toFixed(3).replace(/\.?0+$/, ''))); setTimeout(()=>inputRef.current?.select(),10); } }, [editing])` (remove `value` from deps). Verify by re-running the iter10 playwright script.
critical_code_review_comments: ThresholdValue.jsx (LayerControlAdvanced lines 20-25): useEffect dep `[editing, value]` causes typed text to be clobbered when parent re-renders during edit. Should depend on `[editing]` only.
Dashboard.handleCalRangeChange (line 280-286): snake_case write is correct and consistent with NiivueViewer.getOverlayInfo. Good fix — but it was not the root cause of the threshold edit bug.
NiivueViewer.getOverlayInfo isSigned tolerance (lines 350-354): ±1e-3 fix is sound and verified working.

ThresholdValue: no autoFocus on input — `inputRef.current?.select()` only selects, doesn't focus. fill() works around this in tests but real users may need to click twice. Consider adding `autoFocus` or `inputRef.current?.focus()` before select().

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mask-zero visibility fix CONFIRMED working (no toggle for polar angle or eccentricity). Click-to-edit threshold commit STILL fails — root cause is most likely ThresholdValue.useEffect having `value` in its dependency array (LayerControlAdvanced.jsx line 25), which re-runs setText() on parent re-renders during the edit session and overwrites the user's typed value. Main agent should change deps to `[editing]` only and retest with: toggle polar angle ON, click threshold-hi, fill 90, Enter, assert label contains '90'.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause hypothesis for threshold commit bug: ThresholdValue's useEffect re-syncs `text` to `value` whenever `value` prop changes (deps `[editing, value]`). Sequence: (1) user clicks hi label → editing=true → useEffect sets text='179.913'; (2) parent's `refreshOverlayMeta` setTimeout(60ms) callback fires AFTER toggle, setOverlayMeta updates calMin/calMax, parent re-renders with possibly-changed value identity; (3) useEffect re-fires (value dep), text reset to current value, clobbering user input; (4) user types 90 → text='90'; (5) Enter → commit → parseFloat('90')=90 → onCommit(90). But possibly the clobber happens BETWEEN steps 4 and 5 if another parent re-render is triggered (e.g., niivue draws). Recommended fix: remove `value` from useEffect deps; only seed text once on edit-open.
